name: Haus Enzian
beschreibung:
Quietly situated in Serfaus, Haus Enzian features stylishly furnished apartments for families seeking modern comfort and rapid mountain access.

The village underground stations, cable cars, and hiking trails of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Enzian in Serfaus offers contemporary holiday apartments on the sun-drenched plateau.
